experiment_contract.causal_hypothesis: A lifecycle-pure fusion of the post-attention RMSNorm output into the immediately following residual-add/pre-FF RMSNorm can remove one launch and one BF16 intermediate write/read per layer while preserving both stock BF16 rounding points.
experiment_contract.expected_direction: lower launch count and lower intermediate traffic
experiment_contract.stock_control: Pinned Gemma4DecoderLayer.forward calling post_attention_layernorm, followed by RMSNorm.forward_cuda with residual through FlashInfer fused_add_rmsnorm.
experiment_contract.candidate_change: One row-lifecycle computes both reductions and the residual add, retaining the first normalized row internally but explicitly rounding it to BF16 before the residual update.
experiment_contract.correctness_gate: Complete [32,5376] normalized output and residual must be BF16 bit-identical to the stock two-kernel oracle; an invalid no-intermediate-round control must diverge.
experiment_contract.performance_gate: Do not admit H200 work when the impossible zero-cost bound for the complete selected block is below 1% of the fixed qualified request.
